title: Gate all five scorecard dimensions and require sample size (VC-201-003)
goal: VC-201-003 refuted: summary_ok consults only quality/reliability/latency — resource and operator_effort regressions are invisible to the verdict; task_count is never consulted so a zero-task scorecard declares improvement ('undersampled cannot claim' has no mechanism); thresholds are carried on the judged record itself so 'predeclared' is unenforced (post-hoc edits flip the verdict); refuses_task_count_as_percent is a constant true; and ImprovementScorecard has no production caller. Evidence: crates/susi-gawd/src/tests/vc_201_003_mastery.rs.
